scripts.text: A great stone gate stands before you. The sculpture of a terrible dragon spreads its powerful looking wings.
scripts.translation: 一座巨大的石门矗立在你面前，门上雕刻着一条可怕的巨龙，展开强健的双翼。

scripts.text: Near the bottom of the gate, Laphine tribeswomen have been turned to stone and now look like they are part of the great door.
scripts.translation: 石门底部有几位被石化的拉菲尼族女子，看起来已与巨门融为一体。

scripts.text: Move closer to look more carefully.
Step back.
A mysterious power prevents you from getting too close. It looks like there is something strong beyond the door...
scripts.translation: 神秘的力量阻止你靠近，门后似乎藏着某个强大的存在...

scripts.text: Perhaps there's a great hidden secret beyond the gate, beyond expectation.
scripts.translation: 也许门后藏着超乎想象的秘密。

scripts.text: It would be better to go back to camp and inform the others and ask for help.
scripts.translation: 还是回营地，把情况告诉其他人，寻求帮助吧。

scripts.text: You'll have to obtain the others trust in the expendition camp by working hard.
scripts.translation: 你得在远征营地努力做事，赢得其他人的信任。

scripts.text: A mysterious power prevents you from getting too close. It looks like there is something strong beyond the door...
scripts.translation: 神秘的力量阻止你靠近，门后似乎藏着某个强大的存在...

scripts.text: Perhaps there's a great hidden secret beyond the gate, beyond expectation.
scripts.translation: 也许门后藏着超乎想象的秘密。

scripts.text: It would be better to go back to camp and inform the others and ask for help.
scripts.translation: 还是回营地，把情况告诉其他人，寻求帮助吧。

scripts.text: You'll have to obtain the others trust in the expendition camp by working hard.
scripts.translation: 你得在远征营地努力做事，赢得其他人的信任。

scripts.text: The strange sensation surrounding your body has disappeared
scripts.translation: 笼罩全身的奇异感觉消失了。

scripts.text: When you touch the stone gate, you hear a commanding voice.
scripts.translation: 触摸石门时，你听到了威严的声音。

scripts.text: Wingless one... Our promised words...
scripts.translation: 无翼者... 我们约定的话语...

scripts.text: 'Guardian's spell'!
Take a step back.
Promised words... Guardian's spell... proof of their existence.
scripts.translation: 约定的话语... 守护者的咒语... 他们存在的证明。

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
In the name of Yggdrasiliad, I will accept you as a servant of the Guardian.
scripts.translation: 以世界树之名，我接纳你成为守护者的仆从。

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
I accept your entrance through the Guardian's gate. You are now considered a faithful servant of the Guardian Nidhoggur.
scripts.translation: 准许你通过守护者之门。从此，你便是守护者尼德霍格忠实的仆从。

scripts.text: The voice has disappeared, and the dark power is calming down from behind the stone gate.
scripts.translation: 声音消失了，石门后的黑暗力量也渐渐平息。

scripts.text: As I put my hands on the stone gate, a voice sounded from the depth of my heart.
scripts.translation: 你把手放在石门上，一个声音从心底深处响起。

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
Where are the other servants, so you can work together? Each servant cannot be admitted here individually...
scripts.translation: 其他仆从呢？你们必须共同行动，不能独自进入...

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
Come with at least 1 more servant... Only party leaders can accept admission to Nidhoggur's Nest.
scripts.translation: 至少再带一名仆从来...只有队长能申请进入尼德霍格巢穴。

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
And only 1 representative of you needs to talk to me, so don't annoy me...
scripts.translation: 派一位代表来与我交谈就够了，别来烦我...

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
The loyal servants of the Guardian... what can I do for you?
scripts.translation: 守护者的忠实仆从... 有何请求？

scripts.text: Please allow me to enter.
I want to go in.
I want to leave.
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
The Guardian seems to wish to be alone. I will go in and check, please wait out here.
scripts.translation: 守护者似乎想独处。我进去看看，你们在外面等候。

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
I've recorded your request, are you ready to go inside?
scripts.translation: 请求已记录，准备好进去了吗？

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
If you are ready, I will allow you to enter.
scripts.translation: 准备好了，我就准许你们进入。

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
If you have the dungeon generated already, you can enter it.
scripts.translation: 地下城创建完成后即可进入。

scripts.text: I want to go in.
I want to leave.
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
With the defeat of Nidhoggur's Shadow, the roots of the World Tree Yggdrasil are also affected.
scripts.translation: 尼德霍格的影子被击败后，天地树的根部也受到了影响。

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
After Nidhoggur's Shadow disappears, at least 3 days is needed for stabilizing.
scripts.translation: 尼德霍格的影子消失后，至少需要三天才能恢复稳定。

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
If you have the dungeon generated already, you can enter it.
scripts.translation: 地下城创建完成后即可进入。

scripts.text: I want to go in.
I want to leave.
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
The time limit to enter the dungeon has expired. You must wait for the World Tree to stabilize its power before trying to re-enter.
scripts.translation: 入场期限已过，必须等天地树的力量恢复稳定，才能再次进入。

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
The World Tree Yggdrasil has stabilized. Would you like to enter Nidhoggur's Nest again?
scripts.translation: 天地树已经恢复稳定。要再次进入尼德霍格巢穴吗？

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
If you would like to enter again, please register with me.
scripts.translation: 想再次进入，请向我登记。

scripts.text: A great stone gate stands before you. The sculpture of a terrible dragon spreads its powerful looking wings.
scripts.translation: 一座巨大的石门矗立在你面前，门上雕刻着一条可怕的巨龙，展开强健的双翼。

scripts.text: Near the bottom of the gate, Laphine tribeswomen have been turned to stone and now look like they are part of the great door.
scripts.translation: 石门底部有几位被石化的拉菲尼族女子，看起来已与巨门融为一体。

scripts.text: Move closer to look more carefully.
Step back.
A mysterious power prevents you from getting too close. It looks like there is something strong beyond the door...
scripts.translation: 神秘的力量阻止你靠近，门后似乎藏着某个强大的存在...

scripts.text: Perhaps there's a great hidden secret beyond the gate, beyond expectation.
scripts.translation: 也许门后藏着超乎想象的秘密。

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
An unknown error has occurred.
[Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
You didn't ask to be admitted... You should accept admission first before entering.
scripts.translation: 你还没有申请入场...先取得许可，再进去。

scripts.text: [Yggdrasil Gatekeeper]
Where are the other servants, so you can work together? Each servant cannot be admitted here individually...
scripts.translation: 其他仆从呢？你们必须共同行动，不能独自进入...

scripts.text: [Historian Magniffer]
Sure, the mainland also has lots of interesting adventures... Hello, I am Magnifier, a historian dispatched from the Prontera royal court.
scripts.translation: 当然，大陆上也有不少有趣的冒险...你好

scripts.text: [Historian Magniffer]
Finding another line of work might make for a really worthy job, but only a historian gets to know the world over..
scripts.translation: 别的工作或许也很有价值，可只有历史学家才能纵观整个世界...

scripts.text: [Historian Magniffer]
How this world is organized... and the way of the future! With our studies of the past and present we can predict what is to come.
scripts.translation: 世界如何构成... 未来又将走向何方！研究过去与现在，就能推测将来。

scripts.text: [Historian Magniffer]
We are expecting a lot from you, expert adventurer. So, if you find anything... just tell me.
scripts.translation: 你是经验丰富的冒险者，我们对你寄予厚望。有什么发现... 一定告诉我。

scripts.text: Does Commander Agip want to talk to me? Let's listen to his story.
scripts.translation: 阿吉普指挥官想找我谈谈？那就听听他怎么说吧。

scripts.text: [Historian Magniffer]
Did you find the cave that the fairy tribes treat as a holy place? You are a really tough cookie. What did you find?
scripts.translation: 你找到了妖精族视为圣地的洞穴？真有你的！发现了什么？

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
[Historian Magnifier]
Wait a second... I have a brilliant idea.
scripts.translation: 等一下... 我想到一个好主意。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
Let's see... This book... No... this one...? Hmm... Maybe this...
scripts.translation: 让我看看... 这本... 不对... 这本？嗯... 也许是这本...

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
[Historian Magnifier]
[Historian Magnifier]
Oh, here it is! World Tree Yggdrasil and God's tribes... This is their book!
scripts.translation: 哦，找到了！天地树与神族...这本书讲的就是他们！

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
Maybe you found the central line to enter into the World Tree Yggdrasil!
scripts.translation: 你找到的，或许就是通往天地树的主要通道！

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
If that's true, you've found the greatest discovery since the harnessing of mana. Isn't this exciting?
scripts.translation: 若真如此，这可是人类学会运用魔力以来最伟大的发现！想想就激动，不是吗？

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
But we need a lot more information... Are they refusing you admission?
scripts.translation: 不过，还需要更多资料...他们不让你进去？

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
I will send a message to my assistant who is in the Prontera Library. So, help her find more information.
scripts.translation: 我会捎信给普隆德拉图书馆的助手。你去帮她查找更多资料吧。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
I will definitely help you find a way to enter the World Tree directly so, just believe in me! Okay~!!
scripts.translation: 相信我，一定能帮你找到直接进入天地树的方法！放心吧~

scripts.text: Why are you standing there? Go to my assistant in the Prontera Library!
scripts.translation: 你站在那里干什么？去普隆德拉图书馆找我的助手！

scripts.text: You've come back... Good, how's Naomi? Actually, I don't need to worry about her. She is always cheerful. Haha.
scripts.translation: 回来了啊... 娜奥米怎么样？其实不用担心她，她总是那么开朗。哈哈。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
You look like you have a lot on your mind... Your face is full of curiosity and questions.
scripts.translation: 看你若有所思的样子... 满脸都是好奇和疑问。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
So, did you read the whole story that I have prepared?
scripts.translation: 我准备的那些故事，你都读完了吗？

scripts.text: Not yet.
I read all the stories.
[Historian Magnifier]
Sheesh~ I prepared these stories for you carefully, but you didn't bother to check anything out did you?
scripts.translation: 哎呀~ 我精心为你准备了这些故事，结果你根本没看，是吗？

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
It would be better if you returned after reading all of them. That's very basic data of what we should do for the future.
scripts.translation: 读完再来吧，这些都是今后行动所需的基础资料。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
Hm, good job. Maybe I don't need to check anything else, right?
scripts.translation: 嗯，做得不错。看来我不需要再检查其他东西了，对吧？

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
I sent you to figure out which basic materials will be needed for the jobs ahead of us. You should bring research reports...
scripts.translation: 让你调查，是为了弄清今后工作需要哪些基础资料。你应该把研究报告带回来...

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
You might complain about why I didn't bring any myself... That's because I trust your abilities, don't ever take anything for granted.
scripts.translation: 你或许会问，为什么我不自己去找...那是因为相信你的能力，可别把这份信任当作理所当然。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
But a while ago, while you were tranferring reports from Commander Agip to the mainland, you lost those reports... remember?
scripts.translation: 不过，上次替阿吉普指挥官把报告送回大陆时，你把报告弄丢了... 记得吧？

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
So far, nothing's come up... Was it that somebody attacked you?
scripts.translation: 到现在也没什么线索...当时有人袭击你？

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
Somehow, the truth will come out, but we should be careful of shocking the natives if we go there unannounced and they're not prepared for our arrival.
scripts.translation: 真相总会查明的。不过，不能不打招呼就贸然前往，免得当地人毫无准备，受到惊吓。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
I've talked too much... Anyway, as you know through my report, you've found a great thing!
scripts.translation: 说得太多了...总之，读过我的报告，你也该知道这发现有多重要！

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
Firstly, we should find out more about the place. I expect we can, but... we can't do much without help from others.
scripts.translation: 首先，得进一步了解那里。应该能查清楚，不过... 仅靠我们，能做的很有限。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
I have heard about recent expeditions of adventurers that have tried to contact the tribes... Have you heard anything about this?
scripts.translation: 听说最近有冒险者尝试接触那些部族...你知道什么消息吗？

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
Anyway, let's try to contact them first, to be clear about any caves or treasures.
scripts.translation: 总之，先试着联系他们，把洞穴和宝藏的情况弄清楚。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
For now, you try to contact the Sapha and Laphine tribes, and try to extract information from them.
scripts.translation: 先去联系萨法族和拉菲尼族，看看能打听到什么。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
I'll also keep searching here. If you find anything, come back and let me know.
scripts.translation: 我也会继续查找资料。有发现就回来告诉我。

scripts.text: Okay, let's try to contact them first, to be clear about any caves or treasures.
scripts.translation: 好，先试着联系他们，把洞穴和宝藏的情况弄清楚。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
For now, you try to contact the Sapha and Laphine tribes, and try to extract more information.
scripts.translation: 先去联系萨法族和拉菲尼族，设法打听更多消息。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
I'll also keep searching here. If you find anything, come back and let me know.
scripts.translation: 我也会继续查找资料。有发现就回来告诉我。

scripts.text: Ah, you've come at a proper time. I found a curious thing while looking for reports from Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation: 啊，来得正好。我查找阿鲁纳菲兹的报告时，发现了一件有趣的事。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
Right now, we are standing on part of one of the roots of the World Tree Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 我们此刻站着的地方，其实是天地树的一条树根。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
This spot is connected to World Tree by the root. I think we can expect confrontations between the Sapha and Laphine here eventually, don't you think?
scripts.translation: 这里通过树根与天地树相连。我想，萨法族和拉菲尼族迟早会在这里发生冲突，你觉得呢？

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
As I expected, the cave is the entrance to go to one of Yggdrasil's roots...
scripts.translation: 果然，这个洞穴就是通往天地树一条树根的入口...

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
Did you find anything about the Sapha and Laphine?
scripts.translation: 打听到萨法族和拉菲尼族的消息了吗？

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
Both sides act ambiguously, so... I'm getting worried...
scripts.translation: 双方态度都不明朗... 真让人担心...

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
The two tribes have some trouble amongst their top leaders. It's not anything official, but...
scripts.translation: 两族高层之间似乎有些矛盾。虽然还没有正式消息，不过...

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
Let's report to Commander Agip about the situation so far. Then, we wait on his decision.
scripts.translation: 先向阿吉普指挥官汇报目前的情况，等他决定吧。

scripts.text: Report to Commander Hibba Agip about what we have discovered, since time is dependent on his decision.
scripts.translation: 把我们的发现报告给希巴·阿吉普指挥官吧，接下来的安排得由他决定。

scripts.text: So that's how it is... we were right about some parts of it... it's called the Guardian's Nest.
scripts.translation: 原来如此... 有些地方我们猜对了...那是守护者的巢穴。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
We have gained a large amount of knowledge today, but...
scripts.translation: 今天我们得知了不少事情，不过...

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
What we have figured out... how is it going to influence mankind? It's so unpredictable...
scripts.translation: 这些发现... 会给人类带来什么影响？实在难以预料...

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
This is only the beginning...we will be quite busy from now on.
scripts.translation: 这才刚开始... 今后有得忙了。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
First, report to Commander Agip, then act according to the situation. Let me organize my research findings...
scripts.translation: 先向阿吉普指挥官汇报，再视情况行动。我来整理研究结果...

scripts.text: Sure, the mainland also has lots of interesting adventures... Hello, I am Magnifier, a historian dispatched from the Prontera royal court.
scripts.translation: ，我是普隆德拉王室派来的历史学家马格尼弗。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
Finding another line of work might make for a really worthy job, but only a historian gets to know the world over..
scripts.translation: 别的工作或许也很有价值，可只有历史学家才能纵观整个世界...

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
How this world is organized... and the way of the future! With our studies of the past and present we can predict what is to come.
scripts.translation: 世界如何构成... 未来又将走向何方！研究过去与现在，就能推测将来。

scripts.text: [Historian Magnifier]
We are expecting a lot from you, expert adventurer. So, if you find anything... just tell me.
scripts.translation: 你是经验丰富的冒险者，我们对你寄予厚望。有什么发现... 一定告诉我。

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
The doctor never ever tries to come back, and there're too many things to do... How can I do it all...
scripts.translation: 博士就是不肯回来，事情又堆了一大

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
Hey, you. Please move these books. Put them into shelf 3 row B.
scripts.translation: 喂，你，帮忙搬一下这些书，放到 3 号书架 B 排。

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
Don't you see I am too busy? Don't hesitate. Just do it.
scripts.translation: 没看见我忙得不可开交吗？别磨蹭了，快动手。

scripts.text: Look busy, and take a step back.
Help her just this once.
[Assistant Naomi]
Gosh! Where is-? Where did-? Ugh! It's so difficult!
scripts.translation: 天哪！在哪儿...？放哪儿了...？唉！真难找！

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
Ah... if you're done moving those, then these should go in shelf 3 row B.
scripts.translation: 啊... 那些搬完了，就把这些放到 3 号书架 B 排。

scripts.text: Ah...I...see...
[Assistant Naomi]
Now, I am almost done... Who are you? Are you a new assistant to Dr. Magnifier?
scripts.translation: 好了，差不多忙完了...你是谁？马格尼弗博士的新助手？

scripts.text: He asked me to bring some reports. Didn't he say anything?
scripts.translation: 他让我来取一些报告。他没告诉你吗？

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
Hmm... I haven't seen him in over a year! What's he doing now?
scripts.translation: 嗯... 我都一年多没见过他了！他现在在忙什么？

scripts.text: He said that he would send a message to you... didn't you get it?
scripts.translation: 他说会捎信给你... 没收到吗？

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
Message? ...Let's see... I never expected him to write a message...
scripts.translation: 信？... 我找找...没想到他还会写信来...

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
I will check the mailbox, wait a minute. If you get bored read those books.
scripts.translation: 我去看看信箱，稍等。无聊的话，就翻翻那些书吧。

scripts.text: It's too messy due to lots of stacked books and files. Dr. Magnifier looks like he has a ton of reports.
scripts.translation: 书籍和文件堆得到处都是，显得十分凌乱。马格尼弗博士似乎积累了大量报告。

scripts.text: 'Birth of the World', 'The Fiction of Odin's Myth', 'God's Battle Then After', 'Dreams of the Tribes'. There are a variety of books...
scripts.translation: 《世界的诞生》、《奥丁神话的虚构》、《诸神之战之后》、《部落之梦》。书种类真多...

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
Oh, sorry I took so long. There was too much mail, so it took me a while to find stuff.
scripts.translation: 哦，抱歉让你久等了。信太多，找起来费了些时间。

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
He has sent me mail over 20 times. I did not know that...
scripts.translation: 他居然写了二十多封信，我都不知道...

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
Ah, here's the message about you. He's said to share the information on research and reports.
scripts.translation: 啊，这封提到了你。他说要与你分享研究资料和报告。

scripts.text: What is the Doctor's area of expertise?
[Assistant Naomi]
Ever since 5 years ago, he has been curious about how the world started, and so he began his search for the God of creation.
scripts.translation: 从五年前起，他就对世界的起源产生了兴趣，开始寻找创世之神。

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
He researches combat between Odin and the Gods, and about the Gods' origins and life.
scripts.translation: 他研究奥丁与诸神的战争，以及诸神的起源和生平。

scripts.text: So, did he already know that the Rebirth of Satan Morocc has occurred before?
scripts.translation: 这么说，他以前就知道魔王梦罗克曾经复活过？

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
I can't be sure, but he thought someday it would occur. It broke out earlier than he expected though.
scripts.translation: 不敢确定，不过他认为迟早会发生。只是实际发生得比预料的早。

scripts.text: But Rune-Midgarts approved this research?
scripts.translation: 但是卢恩·米德加兹批准了这项研究？

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
Our academics are not a religion. And they too have curiosity about this world's history.
scripts.translation: 我们做的是学术研究，不是宗教活动。王国也想了解这个世界的历史。

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
The combat of Odin vs. the Gods, and the God's sons and their purpose... The Doctor has researched this his whole life.
scripts.translation: 奥丁与诸神的战争、神之子，以及他们的目的...博士一生都在研究这些。

scripts.text: But those reports haven't come out yet. Have they?
scripts.translation: 但是那些报告还没有公开吧？

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
That's why he sent you here. By the way, this isn't the first time I've heard this.
scripts.translation: 所以他才让你过来。其实，这些事情我以前也听说过。

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
After the establishment of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom and Arunafeltz, the rumors have spread in secret about their tribes, myths, etc.
scripts.translation: 卢恩·米德加兹王国和阿鲁纳菲兹建立后，关于各族与神话的传闻，就一直在暗中流传。

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
Anyway, I should make sure that you read all these books, and I'll just keep doing my work.
scripts.translation: 总之，这些书你都得读完。我继续忙我的事了。

scripts.text: Shouldn't I have filed the books?
scripts.translation: 难道我不应该整理这些书吗？

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
The Doctor said he will pick up the books through another person. Besides, don't you need the basic information on what to do?
scripts.translation: 博士说会派别人来取书。而且，你不也得先了解情况，才知道该做什么吗？

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
Before you go back to the Doctor, you had better read these books. So, I will go back to work.
scripts.translation: 回去见博士前，先把这些书读完吧。我去忙了。

scripts.text: Browse around, to take a look at the books.
Discovery of Heterogeneity
Report of Indigenous Tribes
Satan Morocc has known that he didn't resurrect normally or by himself.
scripts.translation: 魔王梦罗克知道，自己并非正常复活，也不是自行复活的。

scripts.text: Continuously, adventurers from Rune-Midgarts have attacked him and he is slowly losing his power. He would need more time to resurrect completely.
scripts.translation: 卢恩·米德加兹的冒险者不断进攻，魔王梦罗克的力量逐渐衰弱。他还需要更多时间，才能完全复活。

scripts.text: Satan Morocc stopped to destroy the city of Morocc, turning it into a ruined desert, then started to rip the world apart.
scripts.translation: 魔王梦罗克将梦罗克城毁成一片荒漠后，转而开始撕裂世界。

scripts.text: Satan Morocc was worried about those who would give chase, so he created Morocc clones to keep watch behind him.
scripts.translation: 为防有人追击，魔王梦罗克制造了分身，留在身后警戒。

scripts.text: Modeled after Morocc, their appearance made it difficult to go around the time-space gap.
scripts.translation: 这些分身以魔王梦罗克为原型，阻碍人们接近时空裂缝。

scripts.text: Still the adventurers gave chase. They came from all over the world, trying to approach the Dimensional Gorge.
scripts.translation: 冒险者们仍然穷追不舍。他们从世界各地赶来，试图接近次元峡谷。

scripts.text: The reports of these adventurers have been sent to representatives of all kingdoms, and an expedition team has been created to find out more information.
scripts.translation: 冒险者的报告送到了各国代表手中。随后，各国组建了远征队，进一步调查。

scripts.text: The scientists of Schwarzwald created a combination metal, using fragments of metals found in the dimensional gorge.
scripts.translation: 修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的科学家利用在次元峡谷中发现的金属碎片，创造了一种合金。

scripts.text: The Schwarzwald Republic requested approval to find the source of the new metal, and since Rune-Midgarts couldn't complete the test themselves, they finally accepted.
scripts.translation: 修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国申请调查新金属的来源。卢恩·米德加兹无法独自完成试验，最终同意了。

scripts.text: They associated together to gather volunteers. The Assassin Guild was the first to volunteer.
scripts.translation: 双方联合招募志愿者，刺客公会率先响应。

scripts.text: The Assassins have a terrible past with Satan Morocc, so they gathered 18 members to chase him down.
scripts.translation: 刺客们与魔王梦罗克有着惨痛的过往，因此集结了 18 名成员展开追击。

scripts.text: About 3 hours later, all 18 members returned without any problem, and each man and woman shared the information that they had collected.
scripts.translation: 大约三小时后，18 名成员全部平安归来，各自汇报了收集到的情报。

scripts.text: They had discovered another world with a definitively different nature and environment. And indeed, people could also live there.
scripts.translation: 他们发现了一个自然环境截然不同的世界，而且人类也能在那里生存。

scripts.text: The most surprising thing is the flow of time. The 18 assassins had stayed for about 2 weeks in there, yet they returned within 3 hours after departing.
scripts.translation: 最惊人的是时间流速。18 名刺客在那里待了约两周，回来时，这边却只过了三小时。

scripts.text: The last thing to be tested... was to send adventurers who volunteered to explore the new world.
scripts.translation: 最后的测试... 是派遣自愿参加的冒险者，探索新世界。

scripts.text: There was a flood of adventurer applications. Lots of volunteers disappeared over the dimensional gorge, and they brought back new data.
scripts.translation: 冒险者的申请纷至沓来。许多志愿者穿过次元峡谷，带回了新的资料。

scripts.text: The new world could support 3 completely different eco-systems dependant upon the race of people that lived there.
scripts.translation: 新世界存在三种截然不同的生态环境，与当地居民的种族相对应。

scripts.text: The heterogenous phenomenon needed to be studied thoroughly and carefully in order to under the relationship between thair world and ours.
scripts.translation: 要弄清新世界与我们世界的联系，必须对这些异常现象进行深入、谨慎的研究。

scripts.text: Just when it was expected to be impossible to travel into a different world, the first page of a new chapter was opened.
scripts.translation: 正当人们以为无法前往异世界时，一段新历史揭开了序幕。

scripts.text: Long ago, there wasn't a sun, moon, or stars; just empty earth... and Ymir was born. Then, by making sons, Ymir grew.
scripts.translation: 很久以前，没有日月星辰，只有空旷的大地... 尤弥尔在此诞生。随着子嗣繁衍，他的族群逐渐壮大。

scripts.text: But, his sons grew as well and he was killed by Odin, Vili, and Ve; 3 brothers, Gods, that attacked from different sides.
scripts.translation: 他的子嗣也逐渐成长。后来，奥丁、维利和韦三位神明兄弟从不同方向进攻，杀死了尤弥尔。

scripts.text: At that time of Ymir's fall his blood flooded the world... killing all in it's path.
scripts.translation: 尤弥尔倒下时，鲜血淹没世界... 所到之处，生灵尽灭。

scripts.text: Only Hvergelmir of the Sapha tribe escaped from this flooding of blood. And he swore vengeance in Jotunheim, which is covered with foggy snow.
scripts.translation: 只有萨法族的赫瓦格密尔逃过了这场血海。他在风雪迷蒙的约顿海姆立誓复仇。

scripts.text: Currently, one of the Sapha tribe has been discovered from beyond the Dimensional Gorge.
scripts.translation: 如今，次元峡谷的另一侧已发现萨法族的成员。

scripts.text: Other than the Sapha tribe, there was another tribe beyond the time-space gap, known as the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 除了萨法族，时空裂隙另一侧还有一个部族，叫拉菲尼族。

scripts.text: The Laphine tribes gathered as well for an expedition to explore the time-space gap and figure out the World Tree's strange symptoms and perharps a cure method.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族也组织了远征队，探索时空裂隙，调查天地树的异常，并寻找治愈的方法。

scripts.text: The Laphine tribe was charged with the management of Yggdrasil, to establish their lands close to Asgard, and to protect the balance of Yggdrasil's magic power.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族受命管理天地树，在阿斯加德附近建立领地，维护天地树的魔力平衡。

scripts.text: The Laphine tribe has never contacted anyone outside of Asgard. But since they found that Yggdrasil's power if weakening...
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族从未与阿斯加德以外的人接触。然而，他们发现天地树的力量正在衰弱...

scripts.text: They have declared they will attend to the high courts for the first time in 1000 human years, since the end of the battles of Gods vs. Magicians.
scripts.translation: 他们宣布，自诸神与魔法师之战结束一千年后，将首次出席最高议会。

scripts.text: The doctor never ever tries to come back, and there're too many things to do... How can I do it all...
scripts.translation: 堆...我一个人怎么做得完...

scripts.text: [Assistant Naomi]
Don't you see that I'm too busy? Don't dawdle, just go!
scripts.translation: 你没看到我正忙吗？别磨蹭了，快走吧！

scripts.text: [Grumbling Soldier]
Nowadays, the world has turned unstable. I can't even fly comfortably anymore.
scripts.translation: 现在世界越来越不安稳，连飞都飞不舒坦了。

scripts.text: What's with the cave up north?
Who are the Sapha tribesmen?
Hmm. We can talk later.
[Grumbling Soldier]
What? If you wander around there... you might return with injuries.
scripts.translation: 什么？在那边乱逛... 小心带着一身伤回来。

scripts.text: [Grumbling Soldier]
I don't know exactly how to explain it, but it's like it has a bad mood. There are lots of terrible monsters there.
scripts.translation: 说不上来，就是气氛不对劲。那里有不少可怕的魔物。

scripts.text: [Grumbling Soldier]
They whisper to each other, so... something is there... But I don't care...
scripts.translation: 它们总在窃窃私语... 肯定藏着什么...不过我才懒得管...

scripts.text: [Grumbling Soldier]
Might be... those Sapha tribesmen have dug in the cave before... They do have a special talent for digging.
scripts.translation: 也许... 萨法族以前在那个洞里挖过...他们倒真是擅长挖洞。

scripts.text: [Grumbling Soldier]
Oh! It is because of them that we have been living here, a lowdown and dirty city, for over one hundred years.
scripts.translation: 哼！全怪他们，我们才在这破烂肮脏的城里住了一百多年。

scripts.text: [Grumbling Soldier]
They don't care if there's trouble with the Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 天地树出了问题，他们根本不在乎。

scripts.text: [Grumbling Soldier]
They are surely full of bad ideas, so... they have destroyed the Yggdrasil's root.
scripts.translation: 他们满肚子坏水... 天地树的根肯定就是他们破坏的。

scripts.text: [Grumbling Soldier]
We are here to make sure that the Sapha don't make things worse.
scripts.translation: 我们待在这里，就是防着萨法族把事情弄得更糟。

scripts.text: [Grumbling Soldier]
Nowadays, the world has turned unstable. I can't even fly comfortably anymore.
scripts.translation: 现在世界越来越不安稳，连飞都飞不舒坦了。

scripts.text: [Grumbling Soldier]
What can you expect when Manuk giants start to dig into the world to destroy the Yggdrasil...
scripts.translation: 马努克那些巨人挖来挖去，破坏天地树... 还能指望什么...

scripts.text: [Grumbling Soldier]
And the worst thing is... that strange things are strutting along the streets of the towns...
scripts.translation: 最糟的是... 城里居然还有怪东西在街上大摇大摆地走...

scripts.text: [Grumbling Soldier]
Yes, you... What do you think about the way the government is handling this...?
scripts.translation: 对，就是说你...你觉得政府这么处理合适吗...？

scripts.text: [Grumbling Soldier]
Although they ignore your track record, still, one should be careful...
scripts.translation: 就算他们不计较你的来历，还是小心点吧...

scripts.text: SeLarsmar Di marThusVil U SeMushVohl
[Sighing Soldier]
When will we be finished with this combat with the Sapha? Ugghhhh...
scripts.translation: 跟萨法族的仗，到底什么时候才打完？唉...

scripts.text: What's with the cave up north?
Who are the Sapha tribesmen?
Hmm. We can talk later.
[Sighing Soldier]
Well... I'm not sure, but we have avoided going to that area.
scripts.translation: 嗯... 我也不清楚，我们一直不去那一带。

scripts.text: [Sighing Soldier]
Sometimes, the dispatched researchers hang around here... I feel bad that there's nothing to see... without any reason...
scripts.translation: 有时派来的研究员会在这附近转悠...可什么也找不到，看着都替他们难受...

scripts.text: [Sighing Soldier]
But the command officers make sure that there's something hidden in there.
scripts.translation: 不过，指挥官们认定那里藏着什么。

scripts.text: [Sighing Soldier]
We don't know if the monsters there are strong, so we never checked it out. But on a personal level, nobody wants to go there...
scripts.translation: 不知道那里的魔物有多强，所以没去查探。说实话，谁也不想去...

scripts.text: [Sighing Soldier]
I don't know what others think about it... but we've had some trouble with our attitude against the Sapha tribes.
scripts.translation: 不知道别人怎么想... 但我觉得，我们对萨法族的态度确实有问题。

scripts.text: [Sighing Soldier]
We didn't try to solve the problems with talk. We attacked them first.
scripts.translation: 我们没试着坐下来谈，是我们先动手的。

scripts.text: [Sighing Soldier]
Maybe... our command officers don't want to accept other species different than us...
scripts.translation: 也许... 指挥官们根本不愿接纳与我们不同的种族...

scripts.text: [Sighing Soldier]
Don't misunderstand... Recently, we have talked about your particular species and our commanders feel grateful to you.
scripts.translation: 别误会... 最近我们也谈到你们这一族，指挥官们还是很感激你们的。

scripts.text: [Sighing Soldier]
Anyway... I'm just exhausted during this useless and nerve-wracking situation... Sigh.
scripts.translation: 总之... 这种毫无意义、又让人提心吊胆的局面，真是累死人...唉。

scripts.text: [Sighing Soldier]
When will we be finished with this combat with the Sapha? Ugghhhh...
scripts.translation: 跟萨法族的仗，到底什么时候才打完？唉...

scripts.text: [Sighing Soldier]
Frankly, I don't think of you or any Sapha is our enemy. Sigh...
scripts.translation: 说实话，我不觉得你和萨法族是我们的敌人。唉...

scripts.text: [Sighing Soldier]
Is there no way to resolve this by communicating? There's no meaning in useless combat! Geez.
scripts.translation: 难道不能好好谈谈来解决吗？打这种无谓的仗有什么意义！真是的。

scripts.text: VohlLarsmar Ha DielCyatas
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Are you...? Are you the one collecting information from my soldiers...?
scripts.translation: 你是...？就是你在向我的士兵打听情报...？

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
You should be cautious. Our tribe has respected the existence of you humans but...
scripts.translation: 谨慎些。我族一直尊重你们人类，不过...

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
I've taken a great risk in allowing you in here. So be wary.
scripts.translation: 准许你进入这里，我冒了很大的风险。行事小心些。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Don't attract too much attention because that would make your people look bad.
scripts.translation: 别太招摇，免得损害你们人类的形象。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Now, we don't need to talk much about this, so just go back where you came from.
scripts.translation: 这件事我们不必多谈，请原路返回吧。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Unless you have any messages for me...? Your face says you do...
scripts.translation: 还是说... 有话要告诉我？看你的表情，似乎还有事...

scripts.text: No. Nothing. We can talk later.
I intend to stay. For good reasons.
[Splendide Guard]
Sir, I can drag this pest out right now.
scripts.translation: 长官，我这就把这个讨厌的家伙拖出去。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
No. Let's hear an explanation. Good? Now, if you want...
[Commander Lebiordirr]
I have known that, recently, time has broken... so, you're here exploring for a solution, no?
scripts.translation: 我知道最近时空出现了紊乱...你是来寻找解决办法的吧？

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Our tribe has respected you, so just forget about the searching and exploring around here.
scripts.translation: 我族尊重你们，不过，还是别在这里四处搜寻探查了。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
I heard that you are to search for any treasure in the closed cave to the north.
scripts.translation: 听说你想去北边封闭的洞穴寻宝。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
That place is banned by order of the Laphine tribe. So, people can't just go there without permission.
scripts.translation: 那里是拉菲尼族明令禁止进入的地方，未经许可，不得擅入。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
If you can't follow this rule, I will stop associating with you and ban all of your people from here.
scripts.translation: 不遵守这条规矩，我就中止与你们的

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
We still have an unstable relationship with the Sapha, we usually don't worry about outsiders.
scripts.translation: 与萨法族的关系仍不稳定，我们通常无暇顾及外来者。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Now, if you understand this, inform your friends.
scripts.translation: 既然你明白了，请转告你的同伴。

scripts.text: If you can't follow this rule, I will stop associating with you and ban all of your people from here.
scripts.translation: 往来，禁止你们这一族踏入这里。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
We still have an unstable relationship with the Sapha, we usually don't worry about outsiders.
scripts.translation: 与萨法族的关系仍不稳定，我们通常无暇顾及外来者。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Now, if you understand this, inform your friends.
scripts.translation: 既然你明白了，请转告你的同伴。

scripts.text: Why have you come back, outsider?
scripts.translation: 外乡人，你为什么又回来了？

scripts.text: To ask the Laphines about exploring...
scripts.translation: 向拉菲尼族询问探索事宜...

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Exploring what? Choose your words wisely?
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Do we not understand each other? What do you want?
scripts.translation: 我说得还不够清楚吗？你到底想做什么？

scripts.text: I must explore the cave.
[Commander Lebiordirr]
That means... that you are ignoring my warning? Is this your decision or are you just following orders?
scripts.translation: 这么说... 你要无视我的警告？这是你自己的决定，还是奉命行事？

scripts.text: I'm just following orders
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Are you trying to insult me on purpose, outsider?
scripts.translation: 你是在故意侮辱我吗，外来者？

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Why do you want to explore? It better be a very good reason.
scripts.translation: 为什么非要调查？最好有个充分的理由。

scripts.text: It's about Dr. Magnifier's report...
scripts.translation: 关于马格尼弗博士的报告...

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
So... What do I care about an outsider's report?
scripts.translation: 外来者的报告... 与我何干？

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
To protect the Yggdrasil! That's the Laphine's fate. Can you say that about yourself?
scripts.translation: 守护天地树，是拉菲尼族的宿命！你也能说自己肩负这份使命吗？

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Do you have any proof of your birth with Odin and Yggdrasil's blessings?
scripts.translation: 你能证明自己是受奥丁与天地树的祝福而生的吗？

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
I shouldn't say anymore. Please don't take this as being rude but, please go now!
scripts.translation: 不必再说了。别怪我无礼，请立刻离开！

scripts.text: Then I'll ask the Sapha for help.
[Commander Lebiordirr]
What are you talking about, outsider?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么胡话，外来者？

scripts.text: [Splendide Guard]
Sir, I can get rid of this rude outsider if you wish?
scripts.translation: 长官，要不要我把这个无礼的外来者赶出去？

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
No, wait... The Sapha tribesmen know the meaning of that place? Did you ask to associate with them?
scripts.translation: 不，等等... 萨法族知道那地方的意义？你已经请求他们合作了？

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Ah... How tricky... Are you testing us?
scripts.translation: 啊... 真狡猾... 你在试探我们？

scripts.text: [Splendide Guard]
Calm down, sir. I will throw this outsider into prison.
scripts.translation: 冷静点，长官。我会把这个外来者关进监狱。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
No... No, wait. Ok, I will accept it. I can accept your admission into the Holy Sekos.
scripts.translation: 不... 等等。好，我同意，准许你进入神圣塞科斯。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Okay. If you are a servant of the Yggdrasil as you claim to be, I will allow you admission. But I am not responsible for your actions.
scripts.translation: 若真如你所说，是天地树的仆从，我就准许你进入。不过，你的行为由你自己负责。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
And make sure that if you find anything out of the ordinary in there, that you share it with us!
scripts.translation: 还有，里面若有任何异常发现，必须告诉我们！

scripts.text: But of course!
[Commander Lebiordirr]
So... since I have agreed to allow your exploration... Arioss, help them, and take the results.
scripts.translation: 既然准许了调查... 阿利奥斯，协助他们，收集调查结果。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Sir... are you sure? This is an invasion of the Holy Sekos...
scripts.translation: 长官... 您确定吗？这可是侵犯神圣塞科斯...

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Invasion is a harsh word. I am allowing them entrance. Better them than a dirty giant. It might just save our lives...
scripts.translation: “侵犯”说得太重了，我准许他们进入。总比让那些肮脏的巨人进去好，或许还能救我们...

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Here, outsider. Arioss will explain the situation with the giants. Talk with him...
scripts.translation: 外来者，阿利奥斯会向你说明巨人的情况。去找他谈吧...

scripts.text: Outsider. Arioss here will explain the situation with the giants, talk with him...
scripts.translation: 外来者，阿利奥斯会向你说明巨人的情况，去找他谈吧...

scripts.text: Welcome to the Laphine camp in Splendide, outsider... I am Lebiordirr. I am in charge here.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到辉煌领域的拉菲尼营地，外来者

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Be cautious of your actions. We already have lots of problems with the Sapha tribe as it is.
scripts.translation: 行事谨慎些，我们与萨法族之间的麻烦已经够多了。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
If you are cautious with your actions, I won't place any harm on you. Fare well.
scripts.translation: 只要谨慎行事，我就不会伤害你。保重。

scripts.text: I was waiting for you. You came back safe, that's good news. Did you find anything?
scripts.translation: 一直在等你。平安回来就好，有什么发现？

scripts.text: Explain about the guardian Nidhoggur's leave.
scripts.translation: 说明守护者尼德霍格失踪的事

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
What? The Guardian is not in his nest...?
scripts.translation: 什么？守护者不在巢穴里...？

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
And because of his disppearance, the Guardian's Shadow is currently destorying the roots of the World Tree...?
scripts.translation: 因为他失踪了，守护者的影子正在破坏天地树的根...？

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
That's unbelievable. You must be insulting the Guardian's and our pride. I did not provide you with our help for that.
scripts.translation: 这简直难以置信。你这是在侮辱守护者和我们的尊严。我提供协助可不是为了让你说这种话的。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
It's not like that, Commander, they speak the truth.
scripts.translation: 指挥官，并非如此，他们说的是实话。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
What are you saying? Arioss, do not forget your place as the Guardian's priest.
scripts.translation: 你说什么？阿利奥斯，别忘了你身为守护者祭司的职责。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Even though I have not seen it with my own eyes, this does explain why we lost communication with the great World Tree Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 虽然尚未亲眼证实，却能解释为什么我们与伟大的天地树失去了联系。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Do not speak of His Highness, the World Tree Yggdrasil's name so lightly.
scripts.translation: 不要如此轻率地提及天地树陛下之名。

scripts.text: Pass along World Tree Yggdrasil's words.
[Commander Lebiordirr]
His Highness, the World Tree Yggdrasil, said that?
scripts.translation: 天地树陛下真是这样说的？

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
The reason behind all of this... is not because of the Sapha tribe, but because of the sudden leave of the Guardian? And the Guardian has given up on his identity?
scripts.translation: 这一切... 不是萨法族造成的，而是因为守护者突然离去？他还放弃了自己的身份？

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
This must be reported... reported to the High Priest of Alfheim... Unbelievable.
scripts.translation: 必须上报... 向阿尔弗雷姆的大祭司报告...难以置信。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Commander... do we need to alert the rest of the tribe...?
scripts.translation: 指挥官... 要通知族内其他人吗...？

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
You don't need to worry about this, Arioss. As commander, I will handle it. You just pretend nothing happened...
scripts.translation: 阿利奥斯，这件事不必你操心，我会处理。你就当什么也没发生...

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Strange one, thank you for your cooperation in such situations... Please forget what has happened today...
[Commander Lebiordirr]
Arioss, please compensate this strange one for the help. I need to go rest...
scripts.translation: 阿利奥斯，替我酬谢这位外来者。我得去休息了...

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Commander...
Strange one, thank you for your cooperation in such situations... Please forget what has happened today...
scripts.translation: 今天发生的事，请忘掉吧...

scripts.text: Welcome to the Laphine camp in Splendide, outsider... I am Lebiordirr. I am in charge here.
scripts.translation: ...我是莱比奥迪尔，这里的负责人。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
Be cautious of your actions. We already have lots of problems with the Sapha tribe as it is.
scripts.translation: 行事谨慎些，我们与萨法族之间的麻烦已经够多了。

scripts.text: [Commander Lebiordirr]
If you are cautious with your actions, I won't place any harm on you. Fare well.
scripts.translation: 只要谨慎行事，我就不会伤害你。保重。

scripts.text: ThusDurnah Ra SharVeldIyaz U UorAmanDur Yee neaOsaAdor Yee...
scripts.translation: ThusDurnah Ra SharVeldIyaz U UorAmanDur Yee neaOsaAdor Yee...

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Sigh, since it's Commander Lebiordirr's wish, I will cooperate with you...
scripts.translation: 唉，既然莱比奥迪尔指挥官这样决定，我就协助你...

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
You want to go there to find out exactly what that place is?
scripts.translation: 你想去查清那个地方究竟是什么？

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Alright...it's as you have assumed, a place connecting to the World Tree. It's also the Guardian's Nest.
scripts.translation: 正如你猜的，那里与天地树相连，也是守护者的巢穴。

scripts.text: Guardian's Nest?
[Aide Arioss]
Yes, that's the nest of Nidhoggur, the Guardian of the World Tree...
scripts.translation: 没错，是天地树守护者尼德霍格的巢穴...

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Only a marked guardian's servant from the Laphine tribe is allowed to enter.
scripts.translation: 只有拉菲尼族中带有印记的守护者仆从，才获准进入。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
That place was initially closed off from the public, but then the giants of the Sapha tribe turned things around...
scripts.translation: 那里原本不对外开放，直到萨法族的巨人改变了这一切...

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
To obtain more minerals, they started to dig with madness.
scripts.translation: 为了获得更多矿石，他们疯狂挖掘。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
In the end, they have harmed a part of the World Tree's root that lies very close to their mine, and thus, the World Tree became very ill.
scripts.translation: 最后，损伤了矿坑附近的天地树树根，让天地树病得很重。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
After we have arrived here knowing the facts, the World Tree was already in a very bad state due to the many factories built by the Sapha tribe.
scripts.translation: 等我们得知情况赶来时，萨法族已经建起许多工厂，天地树的状况极其糟糕。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Even though, for a long time, we have been attacking the Sapha tribe, trying to force them to leave, they are not so easily defeated, leading to this stalemate.
scripts.translation: 我们长期进攻萨法族，想把他们赶走，可他们并不容易对付，双方因此陷入僵局。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
During this time, your people have travelled through the space-time gap to this land.
scripts.translation: 就在这时，你们穿过时空裂隙，来到了这片土地。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Because of those many unexpected reasons, the Guardian's nest, which was meant to stay hidden deep underground, has been discovered by your race...
scripts.translation: 种种意外之下，原本深藏地下的守护者巢穴，竟被你们发现了...

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Now you understand how serious this situation is. Because of the Sapha tribe, we are no longer able to approach the Guardian, and seek his teachings of wisdom.
scripts.translation: 现在明白事情有多严重了吧。因为萨法族，我们无法接近守护者，向他寻求指点。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
It's very insulting to our pride... but if you can help us enter that place again, and speak to the Guardian, maybe we can find a solution...
scripts.translation: 这让我们的尊严大受打击...但若你能帮我们再次进入，与守护者交谈，也许就能找到解决办法...

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Then we'll leave it to you. As for your request, I will do my best to cooperate.
scripts.translation: 那就交给你了，你的请求，我也会尽力配合。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
I have already told you what you wanted to know... If you need anything else, just let me know.
scripts.translation: 想知道的事，我都告诉你了...还有需要，就来找我。

scripts.text: Ah, you said that there is a strange power blocking the entrance to the Guardian's nest, right?
scripts.translation: 你说，守护者巢穴的入口被一股奇怪的力量挡住了，对吧？

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
That's because only the ones chosen by the Guardian may enter.
scripts.translation: 只有守护者选中的人，才能进入。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
We have been the Guardian's servants for generations, and have been protecting the World Tree ever since.
scripts.translation: 我们世代侍奉守护者，一直守护着天地树。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Before we were captured and brought here, there were 3 servants including me. Our task was to heal the World Tree.
scripts.translation: 被俘并带到这里之前，算上我，共有三名仆从。我们的任务是治愈天地树。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
One was killed in our last war with the Sapha tribe... and the other has been taken captive.
scripts.translation: 一人在上次与萨法族的战斗中阵亡... 另一人被俘了。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
I will give you my proof. Don't worry, I'm just temporarily marking you as a guardian's servant.
scripts.translation: 我把自己的凭证交给你。放心，只是暂时赋予你守护者仆从的印记。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Also, remember this spell, it's needed to open the gate of the Guardian.
scripts.translation: 还有，记住这段咒语，打开守护者之门时要用。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
AnomarDu Ha OdesUdenVer Ie
[Aide Arioss]
remuAlaAsh Mu ModtasAn Yu Dur
[Aide Arioss]
TalsehrDur So CyaReMush Di DielAlaWos Ie RuffserIman Ie
scripts.translation: TalsehrDur So CyaReMush Di DielAlaWos Ie RuffserIman Ie

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Go find the fairy guarding the gate, and say this spell.
scripts.translation: 去找守门的妖精，念出这段咒语。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
The proof and the spell will confirm that you are one of the Guardian's servants.
scripts.translation: 凭证与咒语能证明你是守护者的仆从。

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
Please meet the Guardian, and come back with an answer to everything. I believe in you.
scripts.translation: 去见守护者，带回这些问题的答案吧。我相信你。

scripts.text: Please meet with the Guardian and take a wise answer from him. I will trust you.
scripts.translation: 去见守护者，向他寻求指点吧。我相信你。

scripts.text: Not even caring about this a single bit? What a stupid woman...
scripts.translation: 竟然对此毫不在意吗？真是个愚蠢的女人...

scripts.text: Things have actually become like this... as priests of the Guardian, it's our responsibility...
scripts.translation: 竟然变成了这样... 身为守护者的祭司，我们也有责任...

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
I represent the entire Laphine tribe, and show you our gratitude. This must all be very hard for our commander...
scripts.translation: 我代表整个拉菲尼族向你致谢。这件事对指挥官而言，一定很难接受...

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
It can't compare with the effort you have put in for us... but please accept our token of friendship.
scripts.translation: 这点东西无法报答你付出的努力... 但请收

scripts.text: [Aide Arioss]
If we can help you with anything in the future, we will do all we can to assist you. Once again, thank you.
scripts.translation: 下我们的友谊信物。[副官 阿利奥斯]今

scripts.text: If we can help you with anything in the future, we will do all we can to assist you. Once again, thank you.
scripts.translation: 后若有需要，我们一定尽力相助。再次感谢你。

scripts.text: Never give attention to... um... a blunt woman...
scripts.translation: 千万别去理会...呃...那个粗鲁的女人...

[Splendide Guard]
That man is currently under arrest.
scripts.translation: 那名男子目前已被逮捕。

scripts.text: [Splendide Guard]
You'd better behave, Aide Arioss says that different races shall be treated the same way.
scripts.translation: 最好安分些。阿利奥斯副官说过，不同种族应当一视同仁。

scripts.text: [Splendide Guard]
This is the Splendide office. Don't act impolitely.
scripts.translation: 这里是辉煌领域的办公室。请不要无礼。

scripts.text: ThusDurnah Ra SharVeldIyaz U UorAmanDur Yee neaOsaAdor Yee
scripts.translation: ThusDurnah Ra SharVeldIyaz U UorAmanDur Yee neaOsaAdor Yee

This is the Splendide office. Don't act impolitely.
scripts.translation: 这里是辉煌领域的办公室。请不要无礼。

scripts.text: ThusDurnah Ra SharVeldIyaz U UorAmanDur Yee neaOsaAdor Yee
scripts.translation: ThusDurnah Ra SharVeldIyaz U UorAmanDur Yee neaOsaAdor Yee

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
Guest from the other world, please excuse our rudeness...
scripts.translation: 来自异世界的客人，请原谅我们的无礼...

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
As the leader of the Sapha tribe, I have something very important to tell you. That is why I asked for you...
scripts.translation: 身为萨法族的首领，有件重要的事必须告诉你。所以才请你来...

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
Your race has come to this land not long ago through the space-time gap.
scripts.translation: 不久前，你们穿过时空裂隙，来到这片土地。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
You should have already seen what is going on. We have been at war with the Laphine tribe for a very long time.
scripts.translation: 这里的局势，你应该也看到了。我们与拉菲尼族已交战多年。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
Recently, because you do not understand the current situations, you have done some things that I, as a leader, can't ignore any longer.
scripts.translation: 你不了解眼下的局势，最近做了一些事

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
I hope that your people will becareful of your actions on this land, and terminate any unnecessary interventions.
scripts.translation: 希望你们在这里谨慎行事，停止不必要的干预。

scripts.text: Leave quietly.
Don't know what he's talking about, and ask for details.
[Manuk Field Elite Soldier]
Are we really just letting these people go after they have stirred up problems on our land?
scripts.translation: 在我们的土地上惹出麻烦，就这么放他们走？

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
After what happened, I don't think they know what else they can do. Let me explain.
scripts.translation: 事情发展到这一步，他们恐怕也不知道该做什么。我来解释吧。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
For now, we have acknowledged your race, and have been tolerant towards your activities.
scripts.translation: 我们认可你们这一族，也一直容许你们在此活动。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
But we have recently started to suspect you of being the Laphine tribe's eyes and ears.
scripts.translation: 但最近，我们怀疑你们是拉菲尼族的耳目。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
Not long ago, We have heard that you have found remains in an abandoned cave in the north, and have been conducting investigations and researches regarding it.
scripts.translation: 听说你们最近在北边的废弃洞穴发现了遗迹，正对此展开调查研究。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
We have captured a Laphine tribe priest during the last war, and we have heard that you have had contact with said captive.
scripts.translation: 上次交战，我们俘虏了一名拉菲尼族祭司。听说你们接触过她。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
That captive is the only reference for our tribe, so we have taken good care of her. She is related to your current investigation.
scripts.translation: 那名俘虏是我族唯一的情报来源，所以我们一

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
For your people, who have no direct connections, it is not a place satisfy your curiosity. I hope that you stop your investigations, and mind your own business.
scripts.translation: 你们与此事并无直接关联，那里也不是供你们满足好奇心的地方。请停止调查，管好自己的事。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
If you don't accept our request, then do not expect any cooperations between our races in the future.
scripts.translation: 若不接受这个要求，就别指望两族今后还能合作。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
Because of the war against the Laphine tribe, everything is a mess. But even then, we cannot allow a foreign race to interfere.
scripts.translation: 与拉菲尼族的战争让一切乱成一团。即便如此，也不能任由外族干涉。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
You have heard it all, now please report back to your race.
scripts.translation: 该说的都说了，回去转告你的族人吧。

scripts.text: That captive is the only reference for our tribe, so we have taken good care of her. She is related to your current investigation.
scripts.translation: 直善待她。她与你正在进行的调查有关。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
For your people, who have no direct connections, it is not a place to satisfy your curiosity. I hope that you stop your investigations, and mind your own business.
scripts.translation: 你们与此事并无直接关联，那里也不是供你们满足好奇心的地方。请停止调查，管好自己的事。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
If you don't accept our request, then do not expect any cooperations between our races in the future.
scripts.translation: 若不接受这个要求，就别指望两族今后还能合作。

scripts.text: Recently, because you do not understand the current situations, you have done some things that I, as a leader, can't ignore any longer.
scripts.translation: 。身为首领，我已无法再置之不理。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
I hope that your people will becareful of your actions on this land, and terminate any unnecessary interventions.
scripts.translation: 希望你们在这里谨慎行事，停止不必要的干预。

scripts.text: Do you need me for something, strange one?
Received invitation from the Sapha tribe to cooperate and investigate.
scripts.translation: 向萨法族提出合作调查

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
Cooperate and investigate? What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 合作进行调查？你这是什么意思？

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
It seems like you did not understand what I said. What are you thinking?
scripts.translation: 看来你没听懂我的话。到底想做什么？

scripts.text: Please allow me to investigate the cave.
scripts.translation: 请允许我调查那个洞穴

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
From what I can tell, you are disrespecting my request. Is this your intention, or your people's intention?
scripts.translation: 这是要无视我的要求？是你个人的意思，还是你们全族的意思？

scripts.text: It's our intention.
[Neat Etorr]
Ah, it is not an easy decision. You frighten me.
scripts.translation: 啊，这可不是轻易能做出的决定。你们真让我吃惊。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
But may I ask why you want to do this?
scripts.translation: 不过，能告诉我为什么一定要这样做吗？

scripts.text: Explain Professor Magnifier's theory.
scripts.translation: 说明马格尼弗教授的理论

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
It's surprising that you are able to obtain such results. We also have a similar theory.
scripts.translation: 能得出这样的结论，真令人惊讶。我们也有类似的推测。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
At least we also think that we must use the Laphine prisoner to get information.
scripts.translation: 至少，我们也认为必须从那名拉菲尼族俘虏那里获得情报。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
This problem has been the root of our conflicts with the Laphine tribe. Of course, it may also be an opportunity to resolve them.
scripts.translation: 这个问题是我们与拉菲尼族冲突的根源。当然，也可能成为化解冲突的契机。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
Therefore, it's more of a reason to depend on our own powers. There is no room for you to interfere. Please give up.
scripts.translation: 正因如此，更该靠我们自己解决。没有你们插手的余地，放弃吧。

scripts.text: Give up request, and ask Laphine tribe for help instead.
[Manuk Field Elite Soldier]
You finally showed your true face. I knew you were a spy from the Laphine tribe!
scripts.translation: 终于露出真面目了！我就知道你是拉菲尼族的间谍！

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
Ah...you'd go as far as saying that. What good will it do for you, helping the Laphine tribe?
scripts.translation: 啊... 竟然把话说到这份上。帮拉菲尼族，对你有什么好处？

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
Those obnoxious dwarves offended our right of living, and are trying to get rid of us.
scripts.translation: 那些讨厌的矮人侵犯我们的生存权，还想把我们赶尽杀绝。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
The reason we don't allow anyone to enter that site is because it's full of suspicions.
scripts.translation: 我们不许人进去，正是因为那里疑点重重。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
Alright, I'll approve of your request, and let you investigate the secret the Laphine tribe has hidden inside the cave.
scripts.translation: 好，我同意你的请求。去查清拉菲尼族藏在洞穴里的秘密吧。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
If you promise to share all of your research results and findings, we will accept your request.
scripts.translation: 只要承诺把所有研究结果和发现告诉我们，就准许你调查。

scripts.text: Of course.
[Neat Etorr]
Alright, from now on, we will cooperate with you, and allow you to directly communicate with the Laphine prisoner.
scripts.translation: 好，从现在起，我们与你合作。你可以直接与那名拉菲尼族俘虏交谈。

scripts.text: [Manuk Field Elite Soldier]
Commander...are you sure of this? We don't even know if they're friend or foe...
scripts.translation: 指挥官... 您确定吗？他们是敌是友，我们还不知道...

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
With just our powers, it's impossible to figure out what the Laphine is up to. I think the past has proven that.
scripts.translation: 仅凭我们，弄不清拉菲尼族的意图。过去的经历已经证明了。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
What they're doing right now could potentially lead us to a solution.
scripts.translation: 他们的调查，或许能帮我们找到解决办法。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
Strange one, we hope our cooperation will be a good one. Now please go interrogate the Laphine prisoner.
scripts.translation: 外来者，希望我们合作顺利。

scripts.text: Strange one, we hope our cooperation will be a good one. Now please go interrogate the Laphine prisoner.
scripts.translation: 现在去询问那名拉菲尼族俘虏吧。

scripts.text: Outsider. Welcome to Manuk, the village of the Sapha. I am its representative, Neat Etorr.
scripts.translation: 外来者，欢迎来到萨法族的马努克村。我是这里的代表，尼特·艾托尔。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
We are just a small village, nothing special... but rest comfortably.
scripts.translation: 村子虽小，也没什么特别的... 但请安心休息。

scripts.text: I was waiting for you. It's good that you're safe. Did you find anything?
scripts.translation: 一直在等你。平安回来就好，有什么发现？

scripts.text: Explain the sudden leave of the Guardian.
scripts.translation: 说明守护者突然离去的事

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
So... that's the nest of the Guardian of the World Tree, the sacred grounds for the Laphine tribe.
scripts.translation: 原来... 那里是天地树守护者的巢穴，也是拉菲尼族的圣地。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
But because of the angry leave of the Guardian, his shadow is wreaking havoc on the World Tree?
scripts.translation: 守护者愤然离去后，他的影子正在破坏天地树？

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
If what you're saying is true, then there is no more reason for us to continue fighting the Laphine tribe...
scripts.translation: 若你说的属实，我们就没有理由继续与拉菲尼族交战了...

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
What a huge discovery... So Nidhoggur is no longer the Guardian of the World Tree...?
scripts.translation: 多么重大的发现...这么说，尼德霍格已不再是天地树的守护者...？

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
Nidhoggur's Shadow came to exist in this world, and harmed the roots of the World Tree... what a disaster.
scripts.translation: 尼德霍格的影子出现在世间，破坏天地树的根...真是一场灾难。

scripts.text: Pass along the World Tree Yggdrasil's message.
[Neat Etorr]
Is that what the priest of the Guardian said?
scripts.translation: 守护者的祭司是这么说的？

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
From now on, we need to talk about this with the Laphine tribe.
scripts.translation: 接下来，得与拉菲尼族商量这件事。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
But of course...we don't know if they're reasonable enough...hehe.
scripts.translation: 不过... 还不知道他们讲不讲道理呢... 呵呵。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
This is all we needed from you...What is left is business between us and the Laphine tribe.
scripts.translation: 你的任务完成了...剩下是我们与拉菲尼族之间的事。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
Thank you for helping us with such a huge problem. You may forget about it now.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你帮忙解决这么大的问题。这件事，你不必再操心了。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
It's not a lot, but please this as a token of our appreciation.
scripts.translation: 礼物虽薄，请收下我们的一点谢意。

scripts.text: Strange one, thank you for helping us in the time of need. I will never forget your kindness.
scripts.translation: 外来者，谢谢你在我们需要时伸出援手。这份恩情，我不会忘记。

scripts.text: Outsider. Welcome to the Manuk village of Sapha. I am its representative, Neat Etorr.
scripts.translation: 外来者，欢迎来到萨法族的马努克村。我是这里的代表，尼特·艾托尔。

scripts.text: [Neat Etorr]
We are just a small village, nothing special... but rest comfortably.
scripts.translation: 村子虽小，也没什么特别的... 但请安心休息。

scripts.text: Tkeh likek Ohek QekhlHkl PkedlioH.
[Manuk Guard]
I'm guarding this Laphine prisoner. Leave me alone.
scripts.translation: 我在看守拉菲尼族俘虏，别打扰。

scripts.text: Klekod Oi Thekd Pheid Okei.
[Manuk Guard]
I'm guarding this Laphine prisoner. Leave me alone.
scripts.translation: 我在看守拉菲尼族俘虏，别打扰。

scripts.text: Liek QUekdk Ohei Vue.
[Laphine Prisoner]
You... are not of the Sapha tribe... Are you... an outsider?
scripts.translation: 你... 不是萨法族的人... 是外来者？

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Have you ever come in contact with the Laphine tribe? Have you ever been to Splendide?
scripts.translation: 你接触过拉菲尼族吗？去过辉煌领域吗？

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Please, talk to my people in Splendide. They will come to help me.
scripts.translation: 请去辉煌领域找我的族人，他们会来救我。

scripts.text: What happened to you?
What's in the cave to the north?
Tell me about your tribe.
I will leave you alone.
[Laphine Prisoner]
During out last battle with the Sapha tribe... they caught me and took me prisoner.
scripts.translation: 上次与萨法族交战时... 我被他们抓住，成了俘虏。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
The Sapha tribe attacked first. They are destroying the World Tree.
scripts.translation: 是萨法族先动手的，他们正在破坏天地树。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
That's why the war started. But I don't want to fight with the Sapha tribe anymore...
scripts.translation: 战争就是这样开始的。可我不想再与萨法族打仗了...

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
If it wasn't for that... I wouldn't survive here...
scripts.translation: 要不是这样... 我恐怕无法活到现在...

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Please. Bring this news to all of Splendide. Send someone to save me... or they might kill me.
scripts.translation: 拜托，把消息带回辉煌领域，叫人来救我...不然，他们可能会杀了我。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
There is...
[Laphine Prisoner]
No... I can't tell you... It's the secret of our tribe...
scripts.translation: 不... 不能告诉你... 这是我族的秘密...

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
I just want to say this...if the Sapha tribe intrude that place, we will never forgive them!
scripts.translation: 只能告诉你... 萨法族若敢闯入那里，我们绝不原谅！

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
The Laphines have protected the Yggdrasil World Tree for generations.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族世代守护着天地树。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
We live in a... different time, different land... we came for an expedition.
scripts.translation: 我们住在... 另一个时空，另一片土地...是作为远征队来到这里的。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
After we received reports from our spy about the World Tree's strange symptoms, we recgnized the Manuk's existence.
scripts.translation: 密探报告了天地树的异常，我们这才发现马努克的存在。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
They are mining metal, and in so doing, destroying the World Tree's roots...
scripts.translation: 他们开采金属，破坏了天地树的根...

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
So we dispatched an expedition here. Soonafter, the war with the Sapha began...
scripts.translation: 所以我们派了远征队过来。不久后，与萨法族的战争就爆发了...

scripts.text: The sapha tribe went as far as cooperating with an unknown race?
scripts.translation: 萨法族居然与来历不明的种族合作了？

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
What is your purpose? Why do you want to know what that place is?
scripts.translation: 你有什么目的？为什么要打听那个地方？

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
lright...it's as you have assumed, a place connecting to the World Tree. It's also the Guardian's Nest.
scripts.translation: 正如你猜的，那里与天地树相连，也是守护者的巢穴。

scripts.text: Guardian's Nest?
[Laphine Prisoner]
Yes, that's the nest of Nidhoggur, the Guardian of the World Tree...
scripts.translation: 没错，是天地树守护者尼德霍格的巢穴...

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Only a marked guardian's servant from the Laphine tribe is allowed to enter.
scripts.translation: 只有拉菲尼族中带有印记的守护者仆从，才获准进入。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
That place was initially closed off from the public, but then the giants of the Sapha tribe turned things around...
scripts.translation: 那里原本不对外开放，直到萨法族的巨人改变了这一切...

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
To obtain more minerals, they started to dig with madness.
scripts.translation: 为了获得更多矿石，他们疯狂挖掘。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
In the end, they have harmed a part of the World Tree's root that lies very close to their mine, and thus, the World Tree became very ill.
scripts.translation: 最后，损伤了矿坑附近的天地树树根，让天地树病得很重。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
After we have arrived here knowing the facts, the World Tree was already in a very bad state due to the many factories built by the Sapha tribe.
scripts.translation: 等我们得知情况赶来时，萨法族已经建起许多工厂，天地树的状况极其糟糕。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Even though, for a long time, we have been attacking the Sapha tribe, trying to force them to leave, they are not so easily defeated, leading to this stalemate.
scripts.translation: 我们长期进攻萨法族，想把他们赶走，可他们并不容易对付，双方因此陷入僵局。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
During this time, your people have travelled through the space-time gap to this land.
scripts.translation: 就在这时，你们穿过时空裂隙，来到了这片土地。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Because of those many unexpected reasons, the Guardian's nest, which was meant to stay hidden deep underground, has been discovered by your race...
scripts.translation: 由于种种意外，原本深藏地下的守护者巢穴被你们发现了...

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Now you understand how serious this situation is. Because of the Sapha tribe, we are no longer able to approach the Guardian, and seek his teachings of wisdom.
scripts.translation: 现在明白事情有多严重了吧。因为萨法族，我们无法接近守护者，向他寻求指点。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Hmph...even if I don't cooperate, I know you will find other means to get in...
scripts.translation: 哼... 就算不配合，你们也会想别的办法进去...

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Looking at the current situation of the Laphine tribe, we do not have enough power to surround the Manuk fields, and chase the giants away.
scripts.translation: 以拉菲尼族目前的力量，无法围住马努克地区，把巨人赶走。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Okay, if it has already become like this, I will help you. There are no dead-ends. If you keep going, you will find a solution.
scripts.translation: 好吧，事已至此，我帮你。总有路可走，只要坚持，就能找到办法。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Even if I don't say anything, my situation will not change.
scripts.translation: 就算什么也不说，我的处境也不会好转。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
I have already told you everything you wanted to hear. If you have any other requests, please let me know.
scripts.translation: 想知道的，我都告诉你了。还有需要，就来找我。

scripts.text: Ah, you said that there is a strange power blocking the entrance to the Guardian's nest, right?
scripts.translation: 你说，守护者巢穴的入口被奇怪的力量挡住了，对吧？

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
That's because only the ones chosen by the Guardian may enter.
scripts.translation: 只有守护者选中的人，才能进入。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
We have been the Guardian's servants for generations, and have been protecting the World Tree ever since.
scripts.translation: 我们世代侍奉守护者，一直守护着天地树。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Before we were captured and brought here, there were 3 servants including me. Our task was to heal the World Tree.
scripts.translation: 被俘并带到这里之前，算上我，共有三名仆从。我们的任务是治愈天地树。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
One was killed in our last war with the Sapha tribe...and I have been taken captive.
scripts.translation: 一人在上次与萨法族的战斗中阵亡... 而我被俘了。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
I will give you my proof. Don't worry, I'm just temporarily marking you as a guardian's servant.
scripts.translation: 我把自己的凭证交给你。放心，只是暂时赋予你守护者仆从的印记。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Also, remember this spell, it's needed to open the gate of the Guardian.
scripts.translation: 还有，记住这段咒语，打开守护者之门时要用。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
AnomarDu Ha OdesUdenVer Ie
[Laphine Prisoner]
remuAlaAsh Mu ModtasAn Yu Dur
[Laphine Prisoner]
TalsehrDur So CyaReMush Di DielAlaWos Ie RuffserIman Ie
scripts.translation: TalsehrDur So CyaReMush Di DielAlaWos Ie RuffserIman Ie

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Go find the fairy guarding the gate, and say this spell.
scripts.translation: 去找守门的妖精，念出这段咒语。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
he proof and the spell will confirm that you are one of the Guardian's servants.
scripts.translation: 凭证与咒语能证明你是守护者的仆从。

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Please meet the Guardian, and come back with an answer to everything. And tell the answer to...
scripts.translation: 去见守护者，带回这些问题

scripts.text: [Manuk Guard]
Hey, outsider! Step away from the prisoner!
Please meet the Guardian, and come back with an answer to everything. And tell the answer to...
Yes...I heard your conversation with the Sapha tribe...
scripts.translation: 嗯... 我听到了你和萨法族的对话...

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
If our tribe were to really trust in the Sapha tribe...I don't know.
scripts.translation: 我族若真的相信萨法族... 我也不知道...

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Our hatred towards them has already reached an abnormal level...
scripts.translation: 我们对他们的仇恨，已经深得不正常了...

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
Those giants...can they really be trusted?
scripts.translation: 那些巨人...真的可以信任吗？

scripts.text: [Laphine Prisoner]
It's...it's better if you don't believe the one called Etorr...the minds of the Sapha tribe is unpredictable.
scripts.translation: 最好... 别相信那个叫艾托尔的人...萨法族的心思，谁也猜不透。

scripts.text: [Manuk Guard]
Hey, outsider! Step away from the prisoner!
AmanVilShar Ie DorLuShar Mu Re
[Manuk Field Elite Soldier]
This is Neat Etorr's order. Please come with us to see him.
scripts.translation: 尼特·艾托尔有令，跟我们去见他。

scripts.text: [Manuk Field Elite Soldier]
Bring him to Neat Etorr. All soldiers be prepared.
scripts.translation: 把他带去见尼特·艾托尔。全体士兵，准备！

scripts.text: When a faint light enters your heart, a voice sounds in your head.
scripts.translation: 微光融入你的心中，一个声音在脑海里响起。

scripts.text: [World Tree World Tree Yggdrasil]
It's all over... servants of the Guardian... Hurry up and leave this place.
scripts.translation: 结束了... 守护者的仆从们... 快离开这里。

scripts.text: Who are you?
What do you mean?
[World Tree World Tree Yggdrasil]
I... I am the World Tree Yggdrasil, servant of the Guardian of Nidhoggur, as well as the High Priest leading the Laphine Tribe.
scripts.translation: 我... 我是天地树，守护者尼德霍格的仆从，也是领导拉菲尼族的大祭司。

scripts.text: [World Tree World Tree Yggdrasil]
So you're not priestess of the Laphine Tribe... How did you get in? No, there's no time to answer that.
scripts.translation: 你不是拉菲尼族的女祭司... 怎么进来的？不，没时间问这些了。

scripts.text: [World Tree World Tree Yggdrasil]
Hurry... and leave... leave this place before it's too late.
scripts.translation: 快... 离开... 趁还来得及，离开这里。

scripts.text: [World Tree World Tree Yggdrasil]
The guardian... something's wrong with the guardian. I don't know what made him like this.
scripts.translation: 守护者... 他出了问题。我不知道为什么会变成这样。

scripts.text: [World Tree World Tree Yggdrasil]
This... this is no longer the nest of the Guardian of the World Tree Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 这里... 已不再是天地树守护者的巢穴。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
Darkness took over the Guardian and destroyed all living things... now this place has become the cursed home of monsters.
scripts.translation: 黑暗控制了守护者，毁灭所有生灵...如今，这里已是受诅咒的魔物巢穴。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
Now the vile Nidhoggur's Shadow is wreaking havoc here...
scripts.translation: 邪恶的尼德霍格之影，正在这里肆虐...

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
Now's not too late, hurry and get out... tell the Laphine Tribe about this... tell the commanders of Alfheim...
scripts.translation: 还来得及，快逃出去...把这件事告诉拉菲尼族，告诉阿尔弗雷姆的指挥官们...

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
My soul... it has been trapped here. You're the only ones I can trust now.
scripts.translation: 我的灵魂... 被困在这里。如今只能相信你们了。

scripts.text: Nidhoggur's Shadow?
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
The Guardian Nidhoggur... he's not in the nest.
scripts.translation: 守护者尼德霍格... 已经不在巢穴里。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
He...for some reason abandoned his own shadow, and left.
scripts.translation: 不知为什么... 他抛下自己的影子，离开了。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
All that's left, is the ugly Shadow of the Guardian of Nidhoggur...the Shadow that is going mad.
scripts.translation: 只剩下尼德霍格那丑陋的影子... 已经发狂的影子。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
The Shadow sucked all the nutrients from the World Tree Yggdrasil, and has gone mad when there is nothing more left to obtain. Now, he wants this land.
scripts.translation: 影子吸尽天地树的养分，无可汲取后便陷入疯狂。现在，它又盯上了这片土地。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
Once the ugly Shadow leaves here to steal power from the other World Yggdrasil Trees, there will be great destruction. This world will become hell.
scripts.translation: 若这丑陋的影子离开这里，去夺取其他天地树的力量，将造成巨大的灾难。世界会变成地狱。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
You must... tell the commanders of Alfheim about this, and come up with a plan. Only them...
scripts.translation: 必须... 告诉阿尔弗雷姆的指挥官们，让他们想办法。只有他们...

scripts.text: Is there nothing else we can do?
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
With our current powers...it is impossible to defeat the Guardian.
scripts.translation: 凭我们现在的力量... 无法击败守护者。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
But the one going mad is not the Guardian, but his dark Shadow...maybe we can trap him here...
scripts.translation: 不过，发狂的不是守护者，而是他的黑暗之影...或许能把它困在这里...

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
Are you willing to accept this mission? Even if it means to pay with your life?
scripts.translation: 愿意接受这个任务吗？即便可能付出生命？

scripts.text: Leave it to us.
We can't do it.
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
I thank you deeply for your decision. I will use what is left of my powers to open up the path towards the Guardian's Nest.
scripts.translation: 衷心感谢你们的决定。我会用剩下的力量，打开通往守护者巢穴的道路。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
The path to the Guardian's Nest is just past the waterfall by the large World Tree Yggdrasil to the North. The defensive mechanisms of the Sanctuary will start immediately.
scripts.translation: 北边巨大的天地树旁，瀑布后就是通往守护者巢穴的道路。圣地的防御机关会立即启动。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
Defeat all of Nidhoggur's guardians and go through the waterfall into the nest... and stop Nidhoggur's Shadow there.
scripts.translation: 击败尼德霍格的所有守卫，穿过瀑布进入巢穴...在那里阻止尼德霍格之影。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
The gate will open soon. Go defeat all of the guardians... you must kill them all in 30 minutes before the gate opens...
scripts.translation: 大门很快就会打开，去消灭所有守卫...门开启前的 30 分钟内，必须把它们全部消灭...

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
30 minutes... that's the limit of my powers. Please hurry.
scripts.translation: 30 分钟... 是我力量的极限。请抓紧时间。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
And... Be careful... Be careful of the shadow's power.
scripts.translation: 还有... 小心... 当心影子的力量。

scripts.text: The path to the Guardian's Nest is just past the waterfall by the large World Tree Yggdrasil to the North. The defensive mechanisms will start immediately.
scripts.translation: 北边巨大的天地树旁，瀑布后就是通往守

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
Defeat all of Nidhoggur's guardians and go through the waterfall into the nest... and stop Nidhoggur's Shadow there.
scripts.translation: 击败尼德霍格的所有守卫，穿过瀑布进入巢穴...在那里阻止尼德霍格之影。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
The gate will open soon. Go defeat all of the guardians... you must kill them all in 30 minutes before the gate opens...
scripts.translation: 大门很快就会打开，去消灭所有守卫...门开启前的 30 分钟内，必须把它们全部消灭...

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
30 minutes... that's the limit of my powers. Please hurry.
scripts.translation: 30 分钟... 是我力量的极限。请抓紧时间。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
And... Be careful... Be careful of the shadow's power.
scripts.translation: 还有... 小心... 当心影子的力量。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
The path to the Guardian's Nest is just past the waterfall by the large World Tree Yggdrasil to the North. The defensive mechanisms will start immediately.
scripts.translation: 护者巢穴的道路。防御机关会立即启动。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
Defeat all of Nidhoggur's guardians and go through the waterfall into the nest... and stop Nidhoggur's Shadow there.
scripts.translation: 击败尼德霍格的所有守卫，穿过瀑布进入巢穴...在那里阻止尼德霍格之影。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
The gate will open soon. Go defeat all of the guardians.
scripts.translation: 大门很快就会打开，去击败所有守卫吧。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
The path to the Guardian's Nest is just past the waterfall by the large World Tree Yggdrasil to the North.
scripts.translation: 北边巨大的天地树旁，瀑布后就是通往守护者巢穴的道路。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
Use your powers... and destroy the vile Shadow...
scripts.translation: 运用你们的力量... 消灭那邪恶的影子...

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
This is... all I can do for you...
scripts.translation: 这是... 我能为你们做的全部了...

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
Those who want to taint the sacred Sanctuary of the Guardian... Get out.
scripts.translation: 妄图玷污守护者神圣之地的家伙...滚出去。

scripts.text: What's a woman from the Laphine Tribe doing here...
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族的女子怎么会在这里...

scripts.text: What's happening? Let's go check it out.
scripts.translation: 发生什么事了？我们去看看。

scripts.text: From below the gorgeous stones, a strange breeze is forming.
scripts.translation: 华丽的石块下方吹来一阵奇异的微风。

scripts.text: The strange power slowly surrounds your body, the dimension is starting to shift.
scripts.translation: 那股奇异的力量缓缓包裹住你的身体，空间开始扭曲。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
Thank you. You're the saviour of humans and the Laphine Tribe.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你们。你们是人类和拉菲尼族的救星。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
You've defeated Nidhoggur's Shadow. But...It's not gone for good. Its powers are merely put to sleep.
scripts.translation: 你们击败了尼德霍格之影。不过...它并没有彻底消失，只是力量暂时陷入了沉睡。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
But you have won us plenty of time. This is great.
scripts.translation: 不过，你们为我们争取了充足的时间。这真是太好了。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
Please go and report this to those in charge of Splendide and Manuk.
scripts.translation: 请去把这件事报告给辉煌领域和马努克的负责人。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
As you have seen, neither the Sapha tribe nor the Laphine tribe is at fault for the weakening of the World Tree. It's all because of the Guardian's Shadow...
scripts.translation: 正如你们所见，天地树的衰弱并不是萨法族或拉菲尼族造成的。这一切都是因为守护者之影...

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
The Guardian's insanity...is caused by powers unknown to us... You must tell this to everyone.
scripts.translation: 守护者的疯狂...是某种我们尚不了解的力量造成的...你们一定要把这件事告诉所有人。

scripts.text: [World Tree Yggdrasil]
Now... Allow me to escort you out of the cursed nest.
scripts.translation: 现在...让我护送你们离开这座被诅咒的巢穴吧。

scripts.text: Please let me out.
I want to look around for a while.
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
Is that so... I'll be around if you want to leave.
scripts.translation: 这样啊...想离开的时候，就来找我吧。
